key_insight: FOCUS is a CNS-focused pathology foundation model pretrained on large frozen-section data that improves intraoperative diagnosis and biomarker prediction for brain and spinal tissue.
clinical_relevance: It may help neuropathologists make faster, more granular surgical decisions during frozen-section evaluation, including better lymphoma detection and provisional molecular guidance.
method: Pretrained on 27,930 frozen-section pathology images enriched for CNS tissue
Evaluated on 11 internal diagnostic tasks and 12 biomarker-prediction tasks
Assessed in WHO-aligned hierarchical diagnosis and reader studies with six neuropathologists
evidence_signal: Across internal, temporal, and external cohorts, FOCUS achieved mean AUCs of 0.969 for diagnosis and 0.877 for biomarker prediction, and improved junior readers’ lymphoma sensitivity from 81.6% to 94.7%.
watch_item: Performance is promising, but real-world adoption will depend on prospective validation across diverse institutions, staining quality, and frozen-section artefacts.
paper_title: FOCUS: A Subspecialty Foundation Model for Intraoperative Central Nervous System Pathology
